decision.status: rejected; no gain established; prototype remains unlanded
decision.rule:
Decision rule recorded before the clean sweep campaign, 2026-10-16.

Consider this prototype for production only if the candidate median is at
least 2% below the control median and its maximum observed sample is below
the control minimum. These are practical acceptance criteria for this small
change, not a statistical significance test. Retain all five samples and the
warmup; do not replace samples or repeat the campaign to obtain acceptance.

Otherwise preserve the experiment and its result, leave the sweep
implementation unchanged, and proceed with the current full-suite comparison.
Do not combine these results with the preceding allocation or CPU campaigns.

protocol.rotation: rotate cases by round; rotate each case's listed arms by round plus case position
protocol.timer: guest monotonic seconds; repeated workload plus complete final predicate
protocol.excluded: input/setup, result formatting and final resource cleanup
protocol.failure_policy: retain all attempts; no retries; any failed warmup/sample withholds route comparisons

quiet_window: All task-owned builds, tests, profiling, archive and Git jobs are idle for this window. Five-second host process-name snapshots retain observed activity without unrelated arguments; no external-session quiet attestation. One warmup and five rotated fresh-process samples on CPU 2, uninstrumented binaries, unchanged canonical inputs/counts/predicates, no replacement samples. Both native arms include the same allocation-inline baseline, use the portable CPU default and retain the default GC policy. Only the sweep bitmap publication differs.

host_review.limits: Five-second process-name observations; CPU percentages are process-lifetime averages. Ordinary desktop activity remained. This does not establish exhaustive machine idleness.

preparation.base_selection: explicit origin/main at new worktree creation
preparation.scope: One throwaway sweep bitmap publication experiment; no PR or landing.

common_baseline.semantics: Documented call-site native_alloc alwaysinline plus private Collector::allocate inline(always), identically present in both arms. No allocation-inline benefit attributed to this sweep experiment.

preparation.cpu: Both fresh manifests record guest and Rust cpu=null; portable default, SNAIL_NATIVE_CPU removed from each command environment.
preparation.canonical_inputs: Unchanged raw Wasm, count=1, depth=20, expected result=1, providers, entry, case configuration, input and spec. All copied bytes hash identically to retained production inputs.
preparation.optimized_wasm_parity: Control, candidate, retained production V8 Wasm and the copied Wasm actually executed by validate-v8 are byte-identical.
preparation.algorithm: Keep the current start word in a register, clear a bit there for each dead header, then publish it once when the word completes. Header zeroing, surviving mark clearing, live statistics, finalizer order, region/block policy, exact membership, allocation failure behavior and root lifetimes are unchanged.
preparation.publication_invariant: queue_finalizers runs before sweep. sweep_starts has no callbacks or allocation. No membership observer can run until complete sweep publication; the invariant is commented beside the store.

static_evidence.control: evidence/control-sweep-loop.asm: 0x59cb0 mov mask; 0x59cb7 mov bit; 0x59cba rol; 0x59cbd and-to-memory for each dead object.
static_evidence.candidate: evidence/candidate-sweep-loop.asm: 0x59cb0 btr register for each dead object; 0x59c83 stores retained word at word completion.
static_evidence.caveat: Candidate also stores the unchanged zero bitmap once for each empty word, and stores unchanged words with all live objects. No measured dynamic store or instruction count; final assembly proves only code shape.

correctness.native_predicates: validate-candidate, stats-control and stats-candidate each complete unchanged canonical workload and return result=1.
correctness.v8_predicate: validate-v8 completes unchanged optimized Wasm with result=1, barriers=1, setup_barriers=0.
correctness.forced_gc: Existing native-runner semantic fixture executes natively at SNAIL_NATIVE_GC_INTERVAL=1, exit 0. Includes dynamic arrays, zero-filled reuse, roots, cycles, subtype/identity and tail calls.
correctness.same_gc_counters: Both stats diagnostics: 79 collections; 226122905 allocations; 4328130064 bytes; 72968856 last_live; 121494912 last_occupied; 107839504 peak_live; 3010266 live_objects; 6868 roots; 181891143 fields; 398 reused holes; 1 large allocation.

preparation.diagnostic_limit: All elapsed times under attempts are uncontrolled diagnostics. Single statistics runs show no convincing benefit (control sweep 0.326030s, candidate 0.328760s), so no speedup claim. No timing loops or replacement samples have run.
preparation.retained_profile_interpretation: Original corrected 1ms PC profile sampled mark 32.09%, tracing/collect 11.57%, sweep 11.87%; largest mark and sweep sites follow cold header loads. This local edit targets a smaller repeated bitmap RMW, so its possible payoff is limited.
preparation.rejected_breadth: No new allocator API, layout redesign, mark bitmap, GC policy change or unsafe check removal. Did not pursue per-block line filling because dynamic tiny memset setup could offset current small-object line stores without supporting evidence.
preparation.failures: No build/test/native/V8 failures. Pre-capture read-only Git sandbox and unmatched search-glob failures are retained in setup.txt. Diff exit 1 is expected because the source files differ.
preparation.next: Parent decides whether the verified narrow assembly reduction warrants the planned short paired quiet-window comparison. Independent simplify/Astra cleanup remains for any useful production candidate under the requested workflow.

audit.checks: Exact rotated schedule; successful terminal states and descendant cleanup; actual executable identities; source/input/output hashes; scalar predicates and guest timers; independently recomputed statistics. Host quietness assessed separately.

campaign.checks: Reconstructed rotation, complete unchanged report inventory, actual commands and ELF dependencies, source and input hashes, successful exit and descendant cleanup, raw output hashes, canonical result and guest timer, five-sample statistics.
